name: py-slugify
instruction: Implement slugify.py: def slugify(text: str, max_length: int = None) -> str. Lowercase the text, replace every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with a single '-', and strip leading and trailing '-'. When max_length is given, the result must not exceed it and must be cut at a '-' BOUNDARY so no word is left partial - unless the very first word is already longer than max_length, in which case that word is hard-truncated to max_length. The result never starts or ends with '-' and never contains '--'. Text with no alphanumerics yields ''. A max_length that is not a positive integer raises ValueError.
gateCmd:
python3 - <<'GATEPY'
from slugify import slugify as s
assert s('Hello World') == 'hello-world', s('Hello World')
print('gate ok')
GATEPY
verifyCmd:
python3 - <<'VERIFYPY'
from slugify import slugify as s

def chk(args, want):
    got = s(*args)
    assert got == want, 'slugify%r -> %r want %r' % (args, got, want)

chk(('Hello World',), 'hello-world')
chk(('  Leading and trailing  ',), 'leading-and-trailing')
chk(('Multiple   Spaces',), 'multiple-spaces')
chk(('Punctuation!!! Here???',), 'punctuation-here')
chk(('under_score',), 'under-score')
chk(('CamelCase',), 'camelcase')
chk(('a1b2c3',), 'a1b2c3')
chk(('',), '')
chk(('!!!',), '')
chk(('---',), '')
chk(('a---b',), 'a-b')

# Truncation at a word boundary.
chk(('hello world foo', 11), 'hello-world')
chk(('hello world foo', 12), 'hello-world')
chk(('hello world foo', 5), 'hello')
chk(('hello world foo', 100), 'hello-world-foo')
# The first word alone is too long: hard truncate.
chk(('supercalifragilistic', 5), 'super')
chk(('abcdefghij more', 4), 'abcd')

for text, n in [('hello world foo bar', k) for k in range(1, 25)]:
    out = s(text, n)
    assert len(out) <= n, 'exceeded max_length: %r %d -> %r' % (text, n, out)
    assert not out.startswith('-') and not out.endswith('-'), 'edge dash: %r' % out
    assert '--' not in out, 'double dash: %r' % out

for bad in [0, -1, 'x', 2.5, True]:
    try:
        s('hello world', bad)
        raise SystemExit('no ValueError for max_length=%r' % (bad,))
    except ValueError:
        pass
print('ok')
VERIFYPY
